name: jevgrep
description: Finds the files and source excerpts relevant to a plain-language question about a repository, giving coding agents a starting point before they edit.

skills.name: Code Relevance Search
skills.description: Answers a repository question with relevant files, reading leads, and verbatim source excerpts with line references on stdout.

skills.name: Agent Skill Install
skills.description: Installs the jevgrep skill into detected coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode, per project or globally.

skills.name: Search Scope Preview
skills.description: Counts the files a search under a root may read, grouped by top-level directory, with no provider key or network call.
